title: THE BIBLE : THE BOOK OF OUR FATHERS | Traumatizing Knees Of Pressure!! Leviticus 26

sense.text:
I also will do this unto you: Because of our breaking of God's commandments. That's what he says in the book of Deuteronomy, the 28th chapter, and he also says it here in Leviticus 26.

I will even appoint over you terror: That's what we are facing. We are facing terror, and that's the reason why people are crying in the streets. The brother that just got shot in the back of the head, Andrew Brown, in Elizabeth City, North Carolina. I had his name written down here, just because there's so many of them you can't even keep up with them. It's like from one death to the next to the next.

I will even appoint over you terror: So our jubilance in a verdict was short-lived. As soon as we got all exuberant, dancing in the street, boom, right back at it again, because it's never gonna stop. And there's a reason why it's never gonna stop: because you are the Israelites. That's the reason why it's never gonna stop. The Most High got plans for you, and until we realize as a people that we're gonna do what God has instructed for us to do, it's not gonna happen the way you want it to happen.

Consumption: He's gonna have us to be consumed. That's what he's talking about. He said he gonna have mercy on us, but he's still gonna have us to be consumed. Consumption, meaning that nothing that we do is gonna prosper. Everything that we do is gonna get eaten up by everybody else, gonna get eaten up and taken advantage of. All of the greatness that we have within us as a people, it gets taken from us. We get exploited for all of our talents, all of our riches, monies, whatever it is. We get stripped of it and just left to rot. Even if we quote have what you might consider some nice things and all that, in comparison to what you're supposed to have, we have absolutely zero, because the Most High wants to bless us with the entire planet earth. Not a corner, not a house and a couple of cars. That's not what the Most High is looking for.

And the burning ague: He's going to consume us with the burning ague, disease.

That shall consume the eyes: The things that we see in this society, like no justice. Everybody's crying about justice.

And cause sorrow of heart: That's what we see. As soon as we get a little bit of exuberance and some jubilee, be happy and jolly and all that because you think you got a little bit of justice, boom, here comes some more tragedies, to just let you know, listen, this is not your land. Even the Native American Indians, who this land belonged to, it ain't even theirs. How in the world you think we're going to really get a part of it when the original owners don't even have a part of it? You're going to have them on reservations. What are you reserving them for, and who's doing the reserving? The criminal is doing the reserving, and we talk about justice. No. God got justice in the Bible, and either we gonna get hip to that thing or he gonna destroy us all, because there's only going to be one way.

And ye shall sow your seed in vain: Everything that you plant, the enemy is going to take it. That's what it's talking about. The nations going to take it. Everybody's gonna take it. Everything that you plant, even your children gonna go into captivity, if you wanna talk about literal seeds. Everything that we do, the nations gonna take advantage of it.

For your enemies shall eat it: Your enemies shall prosper off of it. Cursed be your basket and your store, all of that. Why? Because we disobeyed the Father. The Most High tells us to gather ourselves together so that he can get us out of here. That's what we need to do.

And I will set my face against you: Because of our disobedience.

And ye shall be slain before your enemies: That's what's happening now. We are slain before our enemies in the streets, in these schools, in the prisons, in the jails. We're slain in the streets, in the ghettos. Got crack on tap, dope, guns, all kinds of things. All of these things are out there for us to use them and end up killing each other with them and just dying of them.

And ye shall be slain before your enemies: That word never change with God. If we say that we believe in God, we need to understand that the Most High is telling you that you are among your enemies. It's clear. There's no getting around this. I don't know what kind of church you can go to that could read this and turn that around. The loving your enemies that the Bible is talking about is the enemies among your own people, when we go off and do something to each other. But this kind of enemy here is the kind of enemy that hates your guts.

They that hate you: This is the real hate group, that hates the nation of Israel. All our enemies are a hate group against God. All our enemies are a hate group against the Israelites.

They that hate you shall reign over you: They shall rule over us. Could you imagine how terrible that is, for somebody that actually hates your guts, you have to trust them for everything? You have to look to them for justice. You have to look to them for education, look to them for a job. That's how angry we made God, and we have yet to turn our eyes and our desires back towards him.

They that hate you shall reign over you: Shall rule, meaning the justice that they give you is their kind of justice, and you just have to accept it. It's just like going on a job. You know you're worth much more than what you're getting paid, but you have to sit there, and the man tells you, I'm going to give you 20 an hour, 15 an hour, whatever wage, when you're worth 40, and you can't even negotiate that. Why? Because of our disobedience. Keep that in mind. Because of our disobedience, because we're not supposed to be living like this.

And ye shall flee when none pursueth you: You shall be afraid the minute they show up. Any kind of edict that they put out, with trembling. That's what that's talking about. You get a letter in the mail that say something, you trembling. Anything that happened on your job, you're going to get written up, you trembling. That's what it's talking about. We live in panic and fear.

And ye shall flee when none pursueth you: So when nobody's chasing us. That's how scared we are. We are terrified of our enemies, of the so-called white man mainly, but we'll blow each other away for nothing. We'll abort our babies. We do all kinds of evil towards each other.

They that hate you shall reign over you: Everybody's focused on the police department as the scapegoat. Not saying they don't deserve it. I want you to understand that the picture is much bigger than that, because the mentality of the police comes from a society of education. The mistreatment that we get comes from a society of education and media and everything else. So I'm not exonerating the police, none of them, but I want you to know that Black folks are being manipulated to only point their focus in one direction, leaving out everything else. You gotta look at the whole cause of it all.

They that hate you shall reign over you: He said there must be accountability. The accountability that we're hoping for will not be brought forth. Wrong judgment will continue to proceed. That's in the scripture. So don't get relieved into thinking that we got justice. The so-called justice that we get is not a sigh of relief. The deck had to be stacked in terms of George Floyd. Here you had a full video that's just showing the straight out assault from beginning to end, complete murder. It was crystal clear that he was choked to death, handcuffed, excessive force to the max, and they still had to get all kinds of witnesses, and even with that, Black folks still thought that the man might get off. So for us to get justice, you have to go through all of that. That's what our people need to realize. It ain't what you think.

They that hate you shall reign over you: Black people were steadily worrying as they were waiting for the jury to deliver, even though all of the evidence pointed to it. Everything pointed to that the man was guilty. They know that we're in an unjust land. And just because we got, quote unquote, justice, all of a sudden a lot of us went back to sleep, but we don't know the reason why that, quote unquote, justice was given.

They that hate you shall reign over you: For 10 years, all of the police shootings, not one of them was convicted of murder. So what makes you think that all of a sudden justice just came down with this kind of track record? You already got the video. You needed to have eight police persons along with the video, along with bystanders, along with an EMT that's trained in saving lives. Along with all of that, they said we have to completely stack the deck, because if we lose on this one, we're in trouble. There's gonna be a riot everywhere. Incriminating, documented, factual: they had to bring all of this, all of them, just to get a conviction on this guy.

They that hate you shall reign over you: That was what the police had described in terms of what happened. So if the video didn't surface to bring out everything, it would have been left that way. I just want y'all to really get your mind around what went down, and the Most High is causing this because he wants our people to wake up.

precepts.why:
Let's read about justice now, because people think they're getting justice. They ain't getting justice. Let's get right to the base, because you so-called Black folks out here, you thinking that you're getting a measure of justice: oh, finally justice has finally hit. No, that's not the justice. This is justice.

“He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity”: That's justice. That's what the Most High is talking about. That's an eye for an eye, tooth for a tooth. That's God's law. So when people talk about justice, how in the world you're going to talk about justice and you standing on stolen land? I never could have figured that out.

“He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity”: That has not happened yet. And how in the world could the perpetrators of a crime give you the definition of justice? They ain't never gonna give you the proper justice if they're the ones that the justice is gonna be meant to. The Supreme Judge has to look at the two parties and say, you know what, these people were wrong, and you have to pay for that. You can't have the criminal talking about, I'm going to give this amount of justice to you, and we talking about somebody happy. Our people are insane.

sense.text:
Therefore the law is slacked: The initial report there basically was clearing the cops for what they did. The blue wall of silence would have sided with Chauvin. But the public said no. Then Chauvin's case went to what would be called risk management. In different companies they call it different things. They examined the risk. They looked at the people's reaction versus the actions of this man here that the world saw. So risk management's job is to assess the risk on which action we take. If we back him up with the big blue wall, how much damage is it going to cost? If we send him to jail, we just burn him and we spare other things. That's exactly what happened, because they looked at it and they said, wait a minute, this is too egregious. Too many people saw it. The man crying for his mama. They said, Derek, you got to hang for this one. You're on your own. That decision to let Chauvin hang came from way above the police department. That came above the chief. That came above everybody. They ain't gonna like me saying this. That's the reason why I say don't just focus on one area. You Israelites need to understand that.

Therefore the law is slacked: You heard the preacher. Dylann Roof went and shot people up, and they arrested him, gave him a sandwich.

And judgment doth never go forth: Judgment ain't never going to go forth for you Israelites until you realize that you are the people of the Most High and you're supposed to repent. That's the bottom line. You Israelites have to repent, all of us.

For the wicked doth compass about the righteous: As much as we may want to ignore what God is saying because we want to feel joy in the system, you ain't gonna change God's words. God said that, therefore the law is slack, and the proper judgment never goes forward. You have to understand that. The proper justice ain't never gonna go forward.

For the wicked doth compass about the righteous: The wicked surpass us. They're prospering. The prosperity of the wicked seems to have no end.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: And that's what we're going to constantly get. We're going to get the wrong judgment. That's the reason why there's a judgment day from the Most High, because that's when the true justice is going to come down. Right now we're just abiding our time. The Most High told us to work together as brothers, work together sisters, work together as a nation, and work collectively among each other. That's what our purpose is. That's what we're supposed to be doing. And once we do that, underneath God's umbrella, he's gonna protect us. This ain't gonna be another thing where they drop bombs on Black Wall Street and all that. We are God's people. Once we're doing what he said, the Most High say, I got you. So there is a solution. Our brothers and sisters got to realize that we need to repent. Stop celebrating these evil wicked holidays. You're making God mad, and you wonder why people are dying wholesale and getting all these crystal clear racist type of killings. It's crystal clear that it's a racist system that's killing us, and we see the double standard clearly, and wonder why is it happening. Why did you shoot me? Because I'm Black? No, because you're the Israelites, and you're supposed to be doing what the Most High told you to do. That's what the problem is.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: Our hearts go out to our people. Whatever measure of justice that we feel that we can get to make our days just a little bit easier, I'm for that. So don't think that I'm telling us to not seek whatever justice we can get. No. Whatever measure of justice that we can get, try to get it all. But I want us to realize that this is not our rest. The brother say can't sleep, because we can all put ourselves in his shoes. Some of us got family members that were killed by police and different things, so we all can recognize that we have a common injury, all of us together. So we understand the pain of our people.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: He got the right answer. He said it right: this is a never-ending cycle, because we are the Israelites. Every ounce of justice that we think that we're trying to chase and all of that, you're gonna have to fight it until you can't fight no more, until your breath is gone, because the system was never set up for us, period.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: He said that the murder of his brother George Floyd is to be compared to Emmett Till. I know there are connections to the Emmett Till situation, but they're not exactly the same. Derek Chauvin's case in action against George Floyd, I think, shouldn't exclusively be compared to Emmett Till, but rather more closely related to Rodney King. I say this because, although I do understand the connection and respect those facts, and also because we see the hatred that's always displayed for us in the Emmett Till murder, the relativity is more evident in the case of Rodney King, because of the direct source of where the hatred came from. It came from the police. In the case of Rodney King, that was a direct assault on Rodney King from the police. In the case of George Floyd, that was a direct assault and murder against George Floyd. In the case with Emmett Till, you were dealing with, quote unquote, private citizens, aided by the police, because they were involved in it too. But this was done directly by the hands of, quote unquote, citizens. So that's what makes it sort of different.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: It's not just the police. It's a whole system that's involved in it, and the whole system is broken, and the Most High is gonna make sure that it stays broken until you wake up. That's the main point. The reason why we came over here on the slave ships is because this was not a fair system. He brought us into an unfair system. Why? Because we're the Israelites. That's what we have to recognize. This hatred came from the police. It didn't come from all of the police, but whenever we're driving and we're pulled over on a dark highway alone, we don't have the time to try to decide whether these are good police or bad police. We're fearing for our lives. That's what the scripture said. We all have that fear. The mere fact that you're always nervous lets you know that this is not our rest. White folks don't feel this. White people be cursing cops out when the cops be pulling them over, cursing them the hell out: boy, my mama changed your diapers, crap like that. I pay taxes. I pay your salary, boy. That's how they talk to them.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: When we say that our people are crazy, some people might be thinking that we're saying that in a way to beat our people down. That's not what I'm saying. I'm saying that our people are crazy because that willful ignorance is actually a coping mechanism. That's what I'm going to get into. I'm building up to show you the craziness that we are subjected to.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: How many times have you heard a brother whistle? Numerous times. Why is it that he still can remember that particular sound? Because that whistle is associated with death. It's associated with trauma. That's the reason why he remembers it, and this is what happened to our people. The traumatizing knees of pressure and injustice is gonna constantly be on us until we repent.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: When Emmett whistled, they all got in the car and they left, and day one went by, day two went by, and the third day, and they might have thought, you know what, maybe this thing is passed. But they're nervously waiting. It's almost like we were waiting on the verdict. That same trauma: waiting, not knowing if these people gonna still respond. And sure enough, the third day came, and they realized that the three days that we thought that they might have just let it go, they were plotting to kill. They were plotting to murder. And we carry that with us.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: When I was on the job, I had to represent people in the field as a union delegate, and the brother was being charged. They tried to charge him with ogling. They said that the brother was ogling at this white woman. I put everybody on the spot: prove it. So he beat it, but then I said, they're gonna come back for you later. Go to another department. And that's what he did. But that was the point: this is the kind of stuff that gets our people jammed up.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: You got to put yourself in the position of these brothers. Even the Floyd family, because we all are there. We all feel it. We all have this collective injury.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: They basically told him, listen, this is none of your business. Lay down and just ignore what you're about to see. They're telling them this as a kid.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: When Chauvin was on that man's neck, you saw the look that he had on his face. He didn't care, because he like, my boys going to back me up. We don't give a damn about the cameras. We beat the hell out of Rodney King. We got away with that. They all had the confidence. So it's a whole system of them, but somebody at the top said, wait a minute, we got to let this boy hang. Then all of a sudden, eight officers. So they got that first initial statement saying that he died of medical response, all of a sudden officers show up. Somebody pulled the switch. He gotta go.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: Here I am with my family, and my son gets taken up out of the bed. I'm his father, and the son is gone. We already know what's gonna happen. We're in the deep south. And I gotta look at the wife, I gotta look at my other brothers, and they all looking at me, and I got to somehow rationalize this violence that just happened, all because of a whistle. Do you recognize the kind of trauma that comes from just having to make that rationale?

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: Like I said, police was complicit in this thing, or implicit. If they weren't directly involved in it, they were implicitly involved in it. So basically you got complicity here, because he's the one that wanted to bury the body quickly so that nobody will find out about it.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: The reason why we played the Emmett Till murder video is because the family of George Floyd, the brothers, they made the comparison, and again, I don't disavow that. I do see that there are plenty of similarities between the two, and trauma is on George Floyd's family side as well as in Emmett Till's family. Now we're at the part where the sheriff, the head of the police department there, took it upon himself to hurry up and hide murder, to hide the viciousness and the brutality that they did to this boy that didn't even live in that state. He's from Chicago. He come down and he just whistles, and this is what happens to him. And you still have people running around still talking about can we get justice.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: She had to battle with city officials. Let's take it step by step. Her son is butchered, torn up. That's trauma in itself. She's got to bury her own son. It's supposed to be the other way around. Children are supposed to bury their parents, not parents bury the children. She has to deal with that trauma, and then she also has to deal with the trauma of, look, you're not going to hide this crime. So she has to be an advocate of justice. She got to mourn and be an advocate of justice at the same time. That's the level of trauma, brothers and sisters. Look at the pain of this here. Could you imagine the stuff that's running through her mind?

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: She said that she wanted to make sure that the world saw this. So there's another parallel that you can draw. But I wanted to really make the point about George Floyd in connection with what happened with Rodney King. They have a more similar situation.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: You gotta recognize she's not describing someone else. She's describing her son. She's talking about how her son was all chopped up. That's a question: was it necessary to do that to him? To them, yes. You want to know the reason why it was necessary? Because the whole action was to terrorize us. That's the reason why it was necessary. It was necessary to do George Floyd the way they did it, as a terrorist act. The things that was done in that church when Dylann Roof went in there was terrorism. That's what we read out of the Bible: we shall suffer with terror. Here we are, Black folk trying to figure out why these people doing what they're doing. The reason why they're doing it the way they do it is because they're sending a message of terror, and the purpose of terror is to, quote unquote, keep you in your place. That's the whole point of it. The Most High said, they that hate you. That's the point there.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: Can you imagine what kind of courage it took for you to have to tell the funeral director? Because they probably did say, listen, we should close it, and she said, no, I don't care about the trauma right now. The world needs to see what these bastards did to my boy. Could you imagine the mother, how she's feeling? All those words and then some probably went across her mind. Bastards is in the Bible, so don't get mad, just get glad and read.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: So she basically had to say that I got to use my son as a warning to all of y'all, instead of her just being able to bury her son. She shouldn't even have to be burying it at all. That child was supposed to grow up and bury her. But look at the different postures that we have to put on just to survive in this system, and it ain't changed. You're gonna find out it has not changed. The feelings are still there. I don't want to diminish the Emmett Till connection, as I saw with Mrs. Mamie Till, Emmett Till's mother, as she went through an additional level of trauma above the initial trauma of her son being murdered. The additional level was that she had to demand that her son's casket be opened during the funeral of her son Emmett. She wanted her son's brutal, inhumane murder to be shown around the world. The murder of her son primarily came directly from American citizens, and I spell America with three K's: KKK citizens. They didn't come directly from cops, but indirectly, when the police tried to hide the body quickly. So we say show the tapes in this recent situation that's involving Andrew Brown. Brothers and sisters want to see the tape. The family want to see the tape. I'm in agreement with that. That needs to be shown. But are we going to get justice as a result of it? Hell no. And even if that comes down, God is not going to release America from the judgment that it is going to get for what they did to the Israelites.

Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth: The Rodney King beating is more relevant to George Floyd, because it points specifically to the reality that we still seem to ignore, and that's more recent. 1955, that was some years ago, but you had Rodney King, March 3rd, 1991. I remember that date clearly, because I remember where I was when I saw the tape. So comparing that to what happened with George Floyd, you see nothing changed, and they still felt confident that they can get off.

precepts.why:
“Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people”: we know this is talking about slavery. But look at what we just saw in the video: the woman's husband showed up to the house. Not law enforcement: the woman's husband.

“And thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand.” The father, the mother, the cousin: nobody had any might to prevent even the husband from getting Emmett Till taken out of the house. Imagine that. Not even law enforcement. You can't stop this thing, coming in your house and taking your people out. Now that's a horrible thing.

sense.text:
We already read Leviticus, because God already gave us the message. He said he will set his face against us, and we shall be slain before our enemies, and they that hate us shall rule over us, and we shall flee when none pursueth us.

Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness: In other words, the Most High is going to jack the 12 tribes of Israel up for disobedience. He's going to be a moth, and rottenness means decay. He was going to start to bring Israel down, because we did not want to repent.

When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound: Meaning their sins. Whenever we needed certain things, when we saw our sickness and our wounds, meaning that we need aid, we need help, guess where we went? We went to the Assyrians. We went to our enemies. This is what the Most High is saying.

And sent to king Jareb: That was the king of Assyria.

Yet could he not heal you: Yet America is not going to heal you, Black folks. That's the point. That's the reason why I'm breaking this up. America is not going to give you the justice that you think you're going to get. You're not going to get it. The Most High got it recorded that you're not going to get it.

Nor cure you of your wound: He's not going to cure you of your hunger, of the things that you lack. You're not going to get the answer for that thing in the way you want it, like to fully restore us. We're only going to get enough help just to keep us as slaves. They fed us in slavery, in the slave quarters, to keep us alive, to keep on working. That's what's going on now. They just give you just a little bit, just to keep you begging, keep your neck just above water.

I, even I, will tear and go away: The Most High say going to destroy Israel. That's what he said. He gonna rejoice in destroying us, because we refuse to repent. So all of this terrible stuff that we're looking at, even with Emmett Till, all of this, and Michael Brown, Sandra Bland, all of these evils that's coming upon us, God is allowing it, because he's trying to get our attention.

I will take away, and none shall rescue him: Nobody. America is not going to save you. You going to the courts and the judge and all of that, that's not going to save you. As soon as that so-called verdict came out, what happened? Deaths, and wild kinds of shooting has been happening everywhere, right after.

I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence: So what is the purpose of the Most High causing us to get jacked up? Because he's trying to get our attention.

In their affliction they will seek me early: The Most High is trying to get your attention. He's trying to get our people's attention. That's the point.
I will lay thy cities waste: Meaning Edom. He's gonna bring judgment on this system.

Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred: The Most High is telling us that our enemies that hate us, they had a perpetual hatred.

In the time of their calamity: In the time of our calamity. The Most High is saying that you're supposed to be allowing us to get ourselves together, but you're not doing that. You're still persecuting us. You're still killing us and doing all kind of evil to us. They forward the affliction. They're forwarding the affliction.

In the time that their iniquity had an end: That time that our iniquity had an end. When we supposedly had came out of slavery, that was a time for us to be getting ourselves together, but they didn't want to do that. The so-called emancipation didn't mean nothing. Why all of this? Because we refuse to repent. That's the reason why all of this went down.

I will prepare thee unto blood: That's what he gonna do to the nations.

And blood shall pursue thee: The Most High said that he going to prepare them unto blood, and blood shall pursue them, because they love killing us. The Most High going to kill them.

Sith thou hast not hated blood: Since thou hast not hated shedding our blood.

Even blood shall pursue thee: The Most High going to make sure that your blood spill. That's what the Most High is talking about. That's an eye for an eye. That's he that leadeth into captivity.

Sith thou hast not hated blood: Since you did not hate killing our people with the sword. Even blood shall pursue thee: the sword gonna come after you to kill you, just like you killed us, and the Most High gonna give that power. So no, we're not going to get out of these conditions until we change our lives, until we repent.

Sith thou hast not hated blood: Now let's go back to us, in our hoping in vain. We're hoping for this system to give us some justice. Can we all get along? That was 30 years ago. Why would they have to put in there that he was on parole for robbery? That's not why they were chasing him. They wouldn't even know who they were chasing. They're not reading a plate with a car going that fast. And even if it's his car, you don't know if he's driving it. So the reason why they were chasing him was because he was speeding. Did y'all see that there's something around his neck? They had him hog-tied, and they had the string on him to keep him from standing. This is Rodney King, 1991. Whenever he tried to stand up, they pull him back down so he'll fall, and then they could continue to beat him. They did not think they were being recorded, as if that really mattered, because even after the recording they still got off.

Sith thou hast not hated blood: They said he was high on PCP. He had superhuman strength. This is what came out in the trial. So that's the reason why I said the link between George Floyd and this is similar, because they were saying the same thing about George Floyd: fentanyl and all this other stuff, he was hard to handle. It's the same thing. And the defense for Chauvin was saying, well hell, if it worked in L.A., this will work here, because this is the American way. He was confident in it, and then that call came in.

Sith thou hast not hated blood: This is the Edomite. He was the one that recorded on his video camera. They always try to turn things around a little bit, but that still ain't going to change the judgment of God.

Sith thou hast not hated blood: When he said, can we all get along, a lot of us gave him hell. Later on I learned that the reason why he said that was because his lawyers gave him something else to say. He said, I ain't saying this. So he had to just come up with something, and that's why he said that. That's what he said before he died. Over a billion dollars in property damage: they said, Chauvin, you going to do this again? You go hang. That call came down and said, send the police captain, forensics and every damn thing. They say his ass going to jail. We're not having this again. Billions of dollars. Take one for the team. That's what they told him. I know people don't like that, but that's the truth. That's my thought on it, but that's what really happened. There ain't no real justice that just automatically just came down. Almost the whole police department went against him. When do you see that happening? Never. Why? Because we disobeyed God. It's one of the curses, that we're gonna be left few in number.

“And ye shall be left few in number”: That's the reason why babies are being aborted. 19 million babies since 1973. You don't think God is paying attention to that? You don't think that we as a people are paying because of all that murder that we're doing? We're paying for that, even the evil that we've did in the past. 19 million Black babies since 1973 have been aborted, but nobody wants to talk about that.

“Whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude”: So not only are we killing our babies, but our enemies are killing us. We screaming about what's happening with the police and all of that, so a lot of our people are dying on both sides, whether we killing them or whether our enemies are killing them. We are losing it out.

“Whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude”: We were the stars of heaven. The Most High set our numbers, was supposed to be innumerous, but the Most High going to cut those numbers down, because we're so wicked.

“As the Lord rejoiced over you to do you good”: He rejoiced when we were obedient to him. He rejoiced in that.

“So the Lord will rejoice over you to destroy you”: You see that? So the Most High is laughing while we're going through this horrible calamity. This is a terrible thing, but I got to give you the facts, brothers and sisters. You wouldn't respect me if I didn't give you the facts.

“And to bring you to nought”: To bring you to nothing, until you repent. Like I said in Hosea, until you acknowledge your offense. That's what we have to do as a people.

“And ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it”: So we lost our homeland. They got a new edict now. They said that the people that went over there in the 60s, the Israel government said that all those people got to be out of there. Trying to kick them out.

“And there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone”: That's what we're doing in these churches, talking about Christianity, and we also saying the same garbage in Islam. None of those belong to us. We're the Israelites that the Bible speaks of.

“And among these nations shalt thou find no ease”: When we go into captivity, we're not going to catch it easy. We're not gonna find any ease at all.

“Neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest”: So you ain't getting the justice. That's what the Most High is telling you straight up. We're not gonna get justice.

“But the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart”: Praying, waiting on the verdict. Even if they gave him a full count of all counts, that still ain't justice.

I'm gonna go over this scripture later on in another part of this, but I just want to read this here, because this is why all of this is happening to us.

“Wherefore hath the Lord pronounced all this great evil against us?”: Why is all this evil happening against us?

“Or what is our iniquity?”: What did we do against God to make God come against us like this here? The preachers will be telling us.

“Because your fathers have forsaken me”: Because when we were back there, because we're the same spirits back then, generations ago we did the evil. Because our fathers have forsaken the Most High.

“And have not kept my law”: That's what got us into trouble.

“And ye have done worse than your fathers”: So what that means is that we have done worse now than we did when we were back then. We're even worse now. The generations are getting worse and worse, getting closer to that judgment day. That's the point.

“And there shall ye serve other gods day and night”: That's exactly what we read in Deuteronomy: wood and stone, other gods. So what is this other land? The slave ships that brought us over here. So it's letting you know crystal clear that the Most High is pointing to you Israelites.

“Where I will not shew you favour”: And that's exactly why we're catching hell. The Most High say, I'm rejoicing to destroy you, because you refuse to keep my commandments. Here you celebrating Christmas, Valentine's Day and all that garbage, and the Most High is angry, because you're his jewels.

“The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north”: You're going to bring us out of North America. That's what it's talking about. “Behold, I will send for many fishers”: That's what we're doing. We're trying to fish you Israelites out of your sinful ways.
